# dnswiz_ipam_available_subnet (Data Source)

Finds the next free aligned subnet of a given prefix length inside a block, without allocating it. Use it to feed a `dnswiz_ipam_block` or network CIDR. Note: this is a read-time peek — two parallel applies could pick the same range; for concurrency-safe allocation prefer creating the child with an explicit CIDR you manage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the next free /24 inside a block (read-time peek).
data "dnswiz_ipam_available_subnet" "next" {
  block_id      = dnswiz_ipam_block.east.id
  prefix_length = 24
}

output "next_free_subnet" {
  value = data.dnswiz_ipam_available_subnet.next.cidr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `block_id` (String) ID of the block to carve from.
- `prefix_length` (Number) Desired subnet prefix length (must be longer than the block's), for example `24`.

### Read-Only

- `cidr` (String) The next free aligned subnet of that size, for example `10.0.5.0/24`.
